items.markdown:
An **Objective and Key Result (OKR)** pairs an inspirational, qualitative goal with 2–5 measurable metrics that define success.[[1]](https://www.whatmatters.com/faqs/okr-examples-and-how-to-write-them)[[2]](https://www.okrstool.com/blog/okr-examples)

The core formula is: *“I will [Objective] as measured by [Key Results].”* [[1]](https://www.whatmatters.com/faqs/okr-examples-and-how-to-write-them)

### Real-World OKR Examples by Team

Here are examples of effective OKRs across key business functions:

- **Product & Engineering:** Focus on user retention and shipping efficiency (e.g., boosting 30-day retention from 40% to 55% or reducing deployment time to under 10 minutes).[[1]](https://www.christianstrunk.com/blog/okr-examples)
- **Marketing & Growth:** Target organic reach and lead generation (e.g., doubling monthly organic traffic or reducing customer acquisition cost).[[1]](https://www.christianstrunk.com/blog/okr-examples)
- **Sales & Revenue:** Prioritize pipeline expansion and win rates (e.g., building a $30M sales pipeline).[[1]](https://mooncamp.com/okr-examples)
- **HR & People Operations:** Aim for improved recruitment timelines and employee satisfaction metrics.[[1]](https://www.atlassian.com/work-management/strategic-planning/setting-goals/okr-examples)[[2]](https://mooncamp.com/okr-examples)


---

### Good vs. Bad OKR Habits
Effective OKRs focus on measurable outcomes rather than vague statements or simple task completion. For instance, instead of listing a task like "Launch new onboarding flow," a good OKR specifies an outcome such as "Increase onboarding completion from 40% to 70%". Avoid unmeasurable goals or metrics lacking clear baselines and targets.[[1]](https://www.christianstrunk.com/blog/okr-examples)For additional templates and breakdowns, explore guides from [What Matters](https://www.whatmatters.com/faqs/okr-examples-and-how-to-write-them) or enterprise resources via [IBM Think](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/okr-examples).If you'd like, tell me:

- **Which department or team** you are writing OKRs for
- **Your main goal** for the upcoming quarter

I can help draft a custom set of objectives and measurable key results.
